prompt:
Vertical 9:16, a photorealistic ultra-close-up portrait of a back view shot outdoors in the evening. A fictional adult Japanese woman, looking 24-32 years old. The frame includes only the left ear, back of the head, tied hair, neck, nape, and left shoulder, with facial features completely out of frame. The head is turned slightly to the left with the chin slightly down. The ear is in the top left, nape in the center, and shoulder in the bottom left, with a bright backlit margin in the top right.

Hair is dark brown near black, tied in a loose chignon with a single black U-pin visible. The surface is not overly neat, with many fine hairs and stray strands around the neck and ear. A small single pearl stud earring is in the left ear. The skin shows pores, fine hairs, and small natural moles. The clothing is a white cotton blouse or thin shirt visible only on the left shoulder.

Strong golden hour backlight from the low evening sun. Golden rim lights on the hair outline, ear edge, and right side of the neck. The background features large white to pale gold bokeh suggesting a beach or riverside. Shot with an 85-105mm equivalent lens at f/1.8. Precise focus on the nape hairs, ear, and hair knot, with a smooth blur on the shoulder and background. Skin is natural and not overly sexualized or smoothed.

promptZh:
竖屏 9:16，一张在傍晚户外拍摄的写实超近距离肖像。一位虚构的成年日本女性，年龄为 24-32 岁。画面仅包含左耳、后脑勺、束起的头发、颈部、颈背和左肩，面部特征完全在画面之外。头部略微向左转，下巴微垂。耳朵位于左上角，颈背位于中心，肩膀位于左下角，右上角有明亮的背光边缘。

头发颜色为 接近黑色的深棕色，扎成松散的发髻，可见一枚黑色 U 型发卡。表面并不十分整洁，颈部和耳周有许多细小的碎发。左耳佩戴一枚小巧的单颗珍珠耳钉。皮肤可见毛孔、细小汗毛和天然的小痣。服装为 白色棉质衬衫 或薄衬衫，仅在左肩可见。

来自低位夕阳的强烈黄金时刻背光。头发轮廓、耳缘和颈部右侧有金色的边缘光。背景呈现出大面积的白色至浅金色虚化效果，暗示着海滩或河边场景。使用 85-105mm 等效镜头，光圈 f/1.8 拍摄。焦点精准对准颈背发丝、耳朵和发髻，肩膀和背景呈现柔和的虚化。皮肤质感自然，未经过度性化处理或磨皮。
